subject: Renewal negotiation: capacity sync, credits & price stability
messages:
From: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@cardinalbio.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cardinalbio.com, Evan Liu <evan.liu@cardinalbio.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation - pricing runway and stability

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the great partnership this year — usage has ramped faster than we expected across the model families and we want to lock in a path forward that gives Cardinal predictability while enabling a modest expansion. Procurement asked me to surface a few items that are important to us for the upcoming renewal:

- A 6–12 month price hold on core generation/embedding rates while we scale.
- A modest upfront discount tied to a 12-month commit (we're targeting a blended discount in the low double digits if we commit).
- Transferable burst credits we can use for sudden experiments (burst pool that doesn't count against committed monthly SUs but is draw-limited).
- Carry-forward of unused committed capacity up to a percentage to avoid waste during seasonal lulls.

I've attached our usage export (Usage_Report_Q1_Q2.csv) and a redlined renewal we started internally (Cardinal_Renewal_Redline_v2.pdf). Can you let me know what flexibility Redwood has on the above and if we can tie a small onboarding/enablement milestone (3 months ramp plan) to a larger discount?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Torres
Head of AI Platforms | Cardinal Bio
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, procurement@cardinalbio.com
Date: 2026-06-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation - pricing runway and stability

Hi Rachel — great context, and congrats on the growth. Appreciate the attachments.

High-level proposal from our side to balance predictability + flexibility:

- Price stability: 6-month firm price hold starting at renewal effective date, with an option for a one-time 6-month extension if Cardinal hits the ramp milestones we agree on.
- Discount: a tiered uplift — 8% baseline off list for a 12-month renewal; increases to 12% if committed tokens exceed the Q2→Q4 ramp target (we can define the target in the MAP).
- Burst credits: a transferable 250k-token burst pool available for 6 months post-renewal. Unused burst credits expire at the end of month 6.
- Carry-forward: allow up to 20% of monthly committed capacity to roll forward for up to 3 months for seasonal smoothing.

Two operational notes:
1) The 12% upside discount requires an agreed mutual action plan (MAP) with 3 milestones (technical enablement completed, monthly consumption gates, and quarterly business review cadence).
2) We can include an SLA uplift option for dedicated capacity if Cardinal chooses to reserve Dedicated pods; that would come with a separate annex.

I've looped in Ben (solutions engineering) to confirm the burst pool behavior and Monica (finance) to flag commercial approvals and the PO path. If that framing looks workable I can send a redline that captures the exact language for burst credits, carry-forward rules, and the MAP milestones.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow (Jun 3) to align on the MAP and timing?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, procurement@cardinalbio.com
Date: 2026-06-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation - pricing runway and stability

Quick technical clarity on the burst/carry-forward mechanics to avoid surprises:

- Transferable burst pool: we implement this as a shared token bucket scoped to the Cardinal tenant. It can be consumed by any workspace under your org but we can gate consumption by API key if you want team-level budgeting.
- Consumption accounting: burst tokens are metered separately and will not reduce committed monthly true-up usage; they'll appear as a separate line item in usage exports so finance can audit draw patterns.
- Carry-forward: unused committed capacity will automatically convert into a 'rollover balance' up to 20% and will draw before new month commit; older rollovers expire after 3 months.
- Technical prerequisite for rapid bursts: enabling short-lived pre-warmed capacity (adds negligible infra charge) to keep tail-latency within SLA when bursts hit — recommend enabling this during the first milestone of the MAP.

If Cardinal will be running sustained embeddings and generation, we should add a milestone around model-family segregation (so embeddings and generation don't contend on the same pool). That helps keep cost-per-token optimized. Happy to sketch the MAP milestones on the call.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@cardinalbio.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@cardinalbio.com>
Cc: procurement@cardinalbio.com, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation - pricing runway and stability

Olga / team — thanks for the clear proposal. Procurement and I reviewed the outline and the carry-forward clause is important for us. We are comfortable with the commercial framework below and would like to proceed to a legal redline & signature:

- 12-month renewal effective 2026-07-01.
- 8% baseline discount at signing; 12% applied retroactively once Cardinal hits the agreed ramp target (MAP milestone 2) within the first four months.
- 6-month firm price hold with a one-time 6-month extension contingent on MAP success.
- 250k-token transferable burst pool active 6 months post-renewal.
- Carry-forward: up to 20% monthly rollovers, 3 month expiry.

Please send the updated SOW/Amendment and DocuSign link. We will get procurement and legal to review quickly.

Attaching a one-line PO template we need included in the DocuSign envelope.

Evan Liu
Head of Procurement | Cardinal Bio
procurement@cardinalbio.com
